description: ACT-UPD-02, deciding variant: which child value a joined UPDATE leaves, with the child insertion order and an index on the foreign key changed one at a time. P (ID 7, Name 'p') joins C1 (children 10, 11 inserted in that order, no index), C2 (11, 10, no index), C3 (10, 11, index on PID) and C4 (11, 10, index on PID); on each UPDATE P INNER JOIN Cx ON P.ID = Cx.PID SET P.Name = Cx.Tag runs with dbFailOnError after Name is reset to 'p'; RecordsAffected and Name after each. Follow-up probe (status F) for ACT-UPD-02; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
